stops.name: Nelson Piquet
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/april-1990/5/phoenix-revivial ('elected to stop for fresh Goodyears on lap 28'); Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_United_States_Grand_Prix ('on lap 28 he pitted for new ones')
stops.note: 'Of the Goodyear drivers, only Piquet stopped specifically for tyres' (Motor Sport)

notes: Alesi (#4) and Senna (#27) ran non-stop (implied, not stated outright). Berger (#28) pitted for a new nose/wing after hitting the tyres; Wikipedia puts the hit on lap 9, Motor Sport has him 'rejoining the race on lap 15': in-lap unclear, not entered. Patrese (#6), Nannini (#19, two nose stops), Schneider (#10), Martini (#23) and Moreno all stopped (no laps).
